title: Optimizing nanoparticle-mediated drug delivery: insights from compartmental modeling via the CompSafeNano cloud platform
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,1494-1506

Periklis Tsiros, Nikolaos Chimarios, Dimitrios Zouraris, Andreas Tsoumanis, Haralambos Sarimveis, Georgia Melagraki, Iseult Lynch, Antreas Afantitis
Nanoparticles (NPs) holds immense potential for targeted drug delivery in vivo, enhancing therapeutic efficacy while minimizing systemic side effects. Simple compartmental modelling can guide the development of targeted NP-drug delivery systems.
